descriptionHtml: The ADA Foundation's project is innovative. He is the first in the world to implement the concept of a Dog Village, created by Dog Houses. We were the first in the world to develop the concept of Adoption Centers by introducing Dog Houses. Currently, there are 30 of them. Each house looks like a room in an apartment and is a practical reflection of home conditions.
